title: ci(ui-merge): the pre-install import graph reads the repository root's workflows; objectui's prompt files move to the root .github/prompts/
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-tesla"} -->
_Requested by **Tesla** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01AXsQkLFKRdQCqQ3RTr6Jao?thread=cmsg_01AXsQkLFKRdQCqQ3RTr6JaoAqVfFyhsxKuFcEP9YTBj25)_

Part of #25712 (4b PR 2d-3a: the pre-install import graph reads the root workflows, and the prompt files move to the root `.github/prompts/`).
Part of objectstack#25677.

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读(草稿)

- **改了什么:**
  - `check-pre-install-import-graph` 的总体改为从仓库根目录的 `.github/workflows/` 推导。它只收根 workflow 里在 install 之前运行 objectui gate 的步骤,写法有三种:`pnpm --dir ui run <alias>`(经 `ui/package.json` 解析)、`node ui/scripts/<x>`、`pnpm --dir ui exec node scripts/<x>`。
  - `ui/.github/prompts/` 下的 3 个 prompt 文件原样移到根目录 `.github/prompts/`。`check:prompt-keys` 改为在仓库根读取 prompt,在 objectui 根推导 registry。
  - 两个 gate 的测试随之改读根目录,`markdown-test-inputs` ledger 删掉 3 个已移走的路径。
- **为什么改:** 这个 gate 原来读嵌套的 `ui/.github/workflows/`,那里有 10 个永远不会运行的步骤还在引用已删除的 `scripts/objectstack-pin.mjs`,所以它在 `main` 上一直是红的(#25863,24 小时内有 11 个 PR 因此被踢出合并队列)。本 PR 合入后,这一行变绿。prompt 文件移到根目录,VS Code 才能读到。
- **风险与代价(含回滚):** 不动任何 workflow,也不动受管面(`.github/prompts/` 不在受管清单里,也没有 CODEOWNERS 规则)。在 2d-3c 给 `ui` 过滤器加上 `.github/prompts/**` 之前,只改 prompt 的 PR 不会触发 Lint UI 和 Test UI(见 F16)。回滚 = revert 本 PR。
- **席位意见:**(留空)
- **你要做的:** 无。Tier S,由席位落地。

## 席位核对

(left for the dispatch seat)

## Why

GitHub runs only the repository root's `.github/workflows/`. Since the cutover (#25825), objectui's own workflows sit at `ui/.github/workflows/` and run nowhere. `check-pre-install-import-graph` derived its population from that directory. Ten of the steps there still run the deleted `scripts/objectstack-pin.mjs`, so the gate, and `Test UI` with it, has been red on `main` with `unresolved: scripts/objectstack-pin.mjs` (#25863).

This is the first of three PRs that finish 2d (the dispatcher's split of 2026-10-26):
- 2d-3a (this PR, Tier S): the two gate retargets and the prompts move;
- 2d-3b (Tier S): the other 25 test files that read a nested workflow;
- 2d-3c (Tier H): deletes `ui/.github/workflows/**` and `ui/.github/dependabot.yml`, and changes the Lint UI steps.

## What changes

- **`ui/scripts/check-pre-install-import-graph.mjs`.**
  - The workflows are read from `workflowRoot()`, the parent of the objectui root. Only the root workflow steps that run an objectui gate before their job's first install count, in three spellings:
    - `pnpm --dir ui run <alias>`. The alias is resolved through `ui/package.json`'s `scripts`, and every `node scripts/<x>` in its body is a row. This is the spelling the root `ci.yml` prescribes for objectui's commands.
    - `node ui/scripts/<x>`.
    - `pnpm --dir ui exec node scripts/<x>`.
  - A bare `node scripts/<x>` in a root workflow is objectstack's own script, resolved against the repository root, and stays out of the population.
  - The install boundary, the import-graph walk and the findings are unchanged.
  - The self-test gains four cases (the three spellings and the root's own script), for 20 in all. `--list` names the alias each row came through.
- **`check-pre-install-import-graph.test.ts`.**
  - The derivation fixtures use the root spelling (`node ui/scripts/<x>`). One new case covers the alias spelling and the exclusion of the root's own scripts.
  - The real-tree floor lists the four root rows: `type-check-ui` → `check-type-check-coverage`, and `lint-ui` → `check-lint-coverage`, `check-entry-guard`, `check-bash32-floor`.
  - The gate is not in its own derived population until the root Lint UI job runs it, so the self-membership case now walks the gate's graph by name. 2d-3c adds that step, as #25902's comment in the root `ci.yml` schedules.
  - The header pointer check resolves `.github/workflows` against the repository root.
- **Prompts.** `ui/.github/prompts/{component,engine,ui-library}.prompt.md` move to `.github/prompts/` unchanged. VS Code reads prompt files from the workspace root.
- **`ui/scripts/check-prompt-component-keys.mjs`.**
  - `promptsRoot()` (the repository root) is where `.github/prompts/` is read.
  - The registry is still derived under the objectui root. `analyze()` takes the prompts root as an option. A fixture tree passes one directory for both roots, so the fixture cases are unchanged.
  - The CLI defaults to the repository root, and it has a `--prompts-root` flag.
- **`check-prompt-component-keys.test.ts`.**
  - The live-tree cases read the root prompts.
  - Two cases are new: no prompt file is left under the objectui root, and the bare command, as CI runs it, scans the root prompts and passes.
- **`ui/scripts/markdown-test-inputs.mjs`.** The three prompt paths leave the two entries that declared them (`ci-cd-pipeline-doc`, `dollar-dialect-alias-census`), because they are no longer in the objectui tree. `--audit`: 114 candidates, all adjudicated, 81 entries, all present.

### Disposition table

| # | Subject | Retired | Kept / retargeted | Carried by now |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | `check-pre-install-import-graph` population | the read of `ui/.github/workflows/` | **retargeted:** root `.github/workflows/`, ui gates only | root `ci.yml` (`type-check-ui`, `lint-ui`) |
| 2 | floor row `changeset-guard.yml : no-major` | yes | (none) | roster **row 3** (→ sub-issue 4) |
| 3 | floor row `changeset-presence.yml : changeset-presence` | yes | (none) | roster **row 4** (→ sub-issue 4) |
| 4 | floor row `ci.yml : changeset-check` | yes | (none) | roster **row 7**, Changeset Fixed Group Check (→ sub-issue 4) |
| 5 | floor rows `ci.yml : type-check` and `lint.yml : lint` (entry guard) | (none) | **retargeted:** `type-check-ui` and `lint-ui`, plus `lint-ui`'s other two pre-install gates | roster **rows 7 and 16** (ported in PR A) |
| 6 | the four `repo-gates.yml : repo-gates` floor rows | from the floor for now | they rejoin under `lint-ui` in 2d-3c | #25880's port (#25902) of roster **row 24** |
| 7 | "is in its own population" | the membership assertion, until 2d-3c | **retargeted:** walks its own graph by name (no package, nothing unresolved) | 2d-3c adds the gate's root Lint UI step |
| 8 | `.github/prompts/*.prompt.md` (3 files) | (none) | **moved** to the root | root `.github/prompts/` |
| 9 | `check-prompt-component-keys` prompt surface | the read of `ui/.github/prompts/` | **retargeted:** `promptsRoot()` | root `.github/prompts/` |

Untouched here: the pre-install test's wiring and header-count sections still read objectui's `repo-gates.yml`, the gate's home until 2d-3c gives it a root step. `ui/.github/labeler.yml` stays, pending sub-issue 4 (F12 = B).

### Follow-up rows (not folded here)

- **F16.** The root `filter` job's `ui` globs (`ui/**`, the lockfile, the workspace file, `turbo.json`, `ci.yml`) do not match `.github/prompts/**`. So a PR that only changes a prompt runs neither Lint UI (where `check:prompt-keys` runs once #25902 lands) nor Test UI. Proposed for 2d-3c: add `.github/prompts/**` to the `ui` filter in root `ci.yml` (Tier H).
- **F17.** The moved prompts cite paths relative to the objectui root, and objectui's script names. Read from the repository root, some of these are wrong:
  - `packages/components/src/renderers/action/`, `packages/fields/src/widgets/types.ts` and `apps/console` need a `ui/` prefix;
  - `pnpm check:prompt-keys` needs `pnpm --dir ui run check:prompt-keys`.
  - The `packages/spec/...` paths in `engine.prompt.md` already resolve from the root.

  This PR moves the files unchanged. The content edit belongs with 2h (the instruction-file rewrite) or sub-issue 4.

## Verification

This head is `main` `d65cbb61` (with #25940) plus two commits. Test runs are from `ui/`, per `ui/AGENTS.md`.

| Run | Result |
|---|---|
| Gate, real tree: `node scripts/check-pre-install-import-graph.mjs` | ✅ 4 pre-install steps in 2 jobs run 4 gates; 6 modules walked |
| Same derivation over #25902's root `ci.yml` (`6f2cb2ab`) | 18 rows in 2 jobs (`type-check-ui` 1, `lint-ui` 17), 23 modules, 0 findings |
| Gate power: a `typescript` import added to `scripts/check-lint-coverage.mjs` | ❌ `scripts/check-lint-coverage.mjs reaches the package typescript` (reverted) |
| `node scripts/check-pre-install-import-graph.mjs --self-test` | 20 cases pass |
| `node scripts/check-prompt-component-keys.mjs` | OK: 3 prompt files, 32 taught keys, 452 authorable |
| The 2 modified test files plus `markdown-test-inputs`, `dollar-dialect-alias-census`, `markdown-fence-scan` | 5 files, 163 tests passed at this head |
| Whole `scripts/__tests__` suite, at this head | 182 files passed, 2 skipped; 5,369 tests passed, 2 skipped, 0 failed. `check-pre-install-import-graph`, the base red, is green. |
| The 2 modified test files with `ui/.github/workflows/` and `ui/.github/dependabot.yml` moved aside (the 2d-3c layout) | `check-prompt-component-keys`: 47 passed. `check-pre-install-import-graph`: red on `ENOENT ui/.github/workflows/repo-gates.yml`, its sections 4 and 5, which 2d-3c retargets with the gate's root Lint UI step (see "Untouched here"). |
| `pnpm type-check:scripts` | the one error is `packages/components/src/renderers/action/resolve-icon.ts(265,69)` TS2339, identical on unmodified `main`; none in a touched file |
| `pnpm exec eslint --max-warnings=0` (touched files), `lint:coverage`, `check:test-path-roots`, `check:entry-guard`, `markdown-test-inputs --audit` | all exit 0 |

Derived gates (`node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack`): 29 families from this PR's 11 paths (the tool counts each moved file as two). All 29 exit 0, and `--ran` reconciles 29 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN. The slowest were `check:query-options-erasure` (340 s), `check-comment-mask-corpus` (233 s) and `check:engine-double-contract` (73 s).

Push-environment battery (`GITHUB_ACTIONS=true GITHUB_EVENT_NAME=push node scripts/pm/check-dispatch-gates.mjs`, both tiers), at this head: `✓ dispatch-gates self-test: 2182 cases pass.` (fast 1917 cases in 402.5 s, slow 265 in 1144.5 s), exit 0, 0 failed.

CI at this head: 58 check runs, 45 passed, 13 skipped, 0 failed.
